news.title: UNI’s ABSN makes a path for a variety of non-traditional students
news.summary_en: UNI's inaugural cohort of Accelerated Bachelor of Science in Nursing students is a diverse group ranging in age from 20 to 35, all with a common goal of becoming a nurse in just about a year.

news.title: UNI selected for national initiative to strengthen civic dialogue on college campuses
news.summary_en: The University of Northern Iowa has been selected as one of just 12 institutions nationwide to participate in a new initiative aimed at strengthening civic dialogue and preparing students to engage thoughtfully across differences.

news.title: UNI to host 2026 “Halloween House” for children and families
news.summary_en: University of Northern Iowa students will be performing Halloween-themed science demonstrations and supervising hands-on activities at this family-friendly event.
